newsitem.title: UK: Prison officer held hostage in Northern Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Prison officer held hostage in Northern Ireland.

text.p: A prison officer has been taken hostage by two inmates in Magherabery jail north of Belfast, the Northern Ireland prison service said on Monday.
A spokesman said there were unconfirmed reports that two prisoners holding the officer were armed.

Prison sources were unable to give details of the incident but said it happened in a part of the prison holding inmates with links to the outlawed guerrilla Irish National Liberation Army (INLA). The motive was unclear.
The INLA is a small leftwing republican group opposed to Britain's rule over Northern Ireland.
